Hunting matters of the lords von Rosenberg and the counts von Hatzfeldt.

Term: 1532, 1551–1569, 1586–1597, 1619–1662.

Contents: 1. Complaint by the gamekeeper at Crailsheim about Zaisolph von Rosenberg’s hunting in the forests of the Crailsheim district, 1532; 2. disputes between Rosenberg and the Amtmann at Creglingen over hunting in the Rinderfeld, Standort, and Oberndorf districts, 1556; 3. likewise over small-game hunting in the Münster district, 1568; 4. disputes between Rosenberg on one side and Finsterlohe, Berlichingen, the Amtmänner at Creglingen and Röttingen on the other over hunting in the Neubronn, Rinderfeld, and Wermutshausen districts, 1568–1569, 1586, 1597; 5. disputes between Hatzfeldt and Hohenlohe over hunting in the Pfitzingen district, (1559–1569) 1649–1659; 6. examination of witnesses in hunting disputes between Hatzfeldt and the Hollenbach district at Staigerbach, 1662; 7. miscellaneous hunting matters: marking forest boundaries; list of hunts around Haltenbergstetten; hunting yields in 1651 and 1652; hunting rights at Oberstetten; the Creglingen hunter’s stay in the Neubronn district; provisions for hunters; hunting disputes with the Teutonic Order, 1551, 1619–1628, 1647–1662; 8. seizure of hunting nets in Rosenberg by a Bavarian commissioner at Boxberg, 1635; 9. hunting nets in Königshofen, 1646; 10. lists of hunting and fishing nets, 1651; 11. lending hunting nets to Hohenlohe-Schillingsfürst, 1658–1661; 12. list of hunting nets at Maßbach, undated; 13. acorn mast in the Hatzfeldt districts, 1653, 1662.

Extent: 1 volume.
